4/15/2026 3:00 PM Update:
Good afternoon from Crystal Mountain! Today was a classic PNW spring powder day and refills were to be had. The groomers gained a slight refresh and were riding very well. A bit more snow is in the forecast for tonight so get your pass up here and join us tomorrow! 

Fresh snow: A lovely cherry on top.
 Base depth: Still working on it.
 Season review: Builds character.


Note: Daily morning reports will occur at 7am for the remainder of the ski season.
Note: The traverse behind the King is closed and the only access to Silver Basin is via hiking the King. 
Terrain Parks:  Discovery Park, Sudden Drop and Arwine's Park are all open today!

Kid's Ski Free all through this month! Ages 12 and under can pick up a free ticket from Guest Services. Please note there may be limited beginner terrain available as we appraoch the end of the season. 
 
Events: 
  • Pond Skim-April 18: Grab a cold one and catch all of the action as passionate skiers and snowboarders brave the Cascade chill of the pond skim waters and try to impress our judges with their best skim, costume, and splash in hopes of winning a 26/27 Ikon Pass.
  • Meet The Cat Crew-April 19: This free, family-friendly event invites guests of all ages to explore the powerful snowcats that shape your favorite runs and meet the skilled operators who bring the mountain to life overnight. Step up close to real grooming machines, climb inside the cab and chat with our expert team about what it takes to maintain world-class terrain.
  • Mt.Rainier Berm Brawl Banked Slalom-April 25 +26:Get ready to drop into the Mt. Rainier Berm Brawl for a one-of-a-kind banked slalom at Crystal Mountain. This all-ages snowboard event is packed with high-speed action, sick prizes, and good vibes on the slopes. Whether you're racing for the podium or just here for the party, it's time to carve into spring and send it. Register today!
Notes for today: 
  1. $199 Spring 3-Day Passes are on sale now! Ski for just $67 a day, any day of the week, for the rest of the season!  
  2. We're open daily through the 19th, and have a Bonus Weekend scheduled for the 25-26th with service on Green Valley! 
  3. Don't forget to check out Crystal Mountain Outfitters for their Spring Sale going on right now! Save up to 50% on all 25-26 winter items. (Some exclusions may apply) Swing by Brand X and check out all this year's demos for sale at a great price! 
  4. Did you know it just takes 5 Days to be entered to win a 26/27 Ikon Pass? Track your days on the Ikon App and register for RIDE TO WIN 
  5. In case of on-mountain emergency: Call 360-663-3064 or 911 

Mountain Weather 4/15/2026 4:00pm
Forecaster: Bradford Swanson

Synopsis: The low-pressure system that was responsible for Wednesday morning's storm continues to move east, resulting in the potential for some light lingering showers Wednesday night. With cooling temperatures and a shift to Northwest flow, we could squeeze a couple more inches of snow out of this before we transition back to high pressure. Northwest flow brings cold temperatures, but strong April sun brings intense daytime warming. Starting on Thursday, expect extreme diurnal swings, from cold overnight temperatures to hot, balmy daytime temperatures. In addition, a cut-off low is forming under this large ridge. This smaller system is just strong enough to continue to throw clouds our way and block some of the sunshine we all desire so badly this time of year. Clouds will come in all sorts of different forms this week, from high clouds with sun breaks to impenetrable valley fog, so stay on your toes. Expect generally light winds throughout the forecast period.
